method: Manual exact source branch contract to ordered current-run observations. NOT RUN is not an environment blocker. PASS means this bounded observed branch, including valid refusal when expected; it is not product/accessibility/release acceptance. Static definition candidate coverage is separate.

private_genuine_supplement.scope: Existing reviewed one-Person distinct enrollment/query pair, admitted real ONNX, final saved profile and graceful restart

attempts.classification: audit capture-wrapper selector ambiguity, not product defect

private_genuine_supplement.privacy: Original photographic images, model declarations and raw reports remain private; no extra source branches inferred.

limits: No source task or branch result is inherited from historical QA or the lexical JSX scanner.
A branch with several slash-delimited/composite values stays PARTIAL when only some values or controls were sampled.
Keyboard/accessibility failures and usability findings belong to findings/review; an expected security/domain refusal is a successfully observed guard.
All 60 task contracts and all 509 branch/state contracts remain accounted for, including unexecuted paths.
Windows packaged licensing/signing and installer acceptance are outside this macOS source execution.
Private genuine source/data checks supplement but do not silently pass missing UI branch states.
